intended_rationale: Actual high-tensile grade is not rank-comparable with a normal-strength required grade.

source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: Steel grades of plating for hull structures are to be not less than those given in Table 8 based on the as-built thickness, the Polar Class and the material class of structural members according to I2.12.2.

contract.comparisonModel: For every represented steelGradeRequirementCase, select the exact required grade from iacsUrI2Table8 using ship polarClass plus case asBuiltPlateThickness, steelMaterialClass and steelStrengthCategory. Missing selectors or an applicable selection without a required grade fail. The actual grade must have rank greater than or equal to the required grade only within the same steelStrengthCategory; NOT_APPLICABLE combinations impose no grade result.
contract.encodingPattern: Structured deterministic table selection plus family-scoped rank comparison
contract.universalScopePolicy: Validate every represented steelGradeRequirementCase; do not impose independent top-level case existence.
contract.verificationPolicyBasis: The category policy is based on the source requirement and intrinsic verification method. It is independent of whether any particular LLM model previously succeeded or failed to generate a SHACL shape.

proof.meaning: Local Table-8 cell only: PC3, normal strength, material class One, thickness 17.5 mm selects source grade D. In this query band=3 and PC1-5 select D in the second IF after the B branch is false. F010 fails !BOUND(required); F011 fails required!=D; F012 fails actualRank<requiredRank; F013 fails the normal-strength family membership test. The table implementation outside this observed cell is not certified by this binding.
proof.query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                ?ship a nltl:ship ;
                      nltl:polarClass ?pc ;
                      nltl:hasSteelGradeRequirementCase $this .
                $this nltl:asBuiltPlateThickness ?thicknessNode ;
                      nltl:steelMaterialClass ?material ;
                      nltl:steelStrengthCategory ?strength ;
                      nltl:actualHullStructuralSteelGrade ?actual .
                ?thicknessNode qudt:numericValue ?thickness .
                BIND(
                    IF(?thickness <= 10, 1,
                    IF(?thickness <= 15, 2,
                    IF(?thickness <= 20, 3,
                    IF(?thickness <= 25, 4,
                    IF(?thickness <= 30, 5,
                    IF(?thickness <= 35, 6,
                    IF(?thickness <= 40, 7,
                    IF(?thickness <= 45, 8,
                    IF(?thickness <= 50, 9, 0)))))))))
                    AS ?band
                )
                BIND((?pc IN (nltl:polarClassPc1, nltl:polarClassPc2, nltl:polarClassPc3)) AS ?pc13)
                BIND((?pc IN (nltl:polarClassPc1, nltl:polarClassPc2, nltl:polarClassPc3, nltl:polarClassPc4, nltl:polarClassPc5)) AS ?pc15)
                BIND((?pc IN (nltl:polarClassPc4, nltl:polarClassPc5)) AS ?pc45)
                BIND((?pc IN (nltl:polarClassPc6, nltl:polarClassPc7)) AS ?pc67)

                BIND(
                    IF(
                        (
                            ?strength = nltl:normalStrengthSteelCategory &&
                            (
                                (?band = 1 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo)) ||
                                (?band >= 2 && ?band <= 4 && ?pc67 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo)) ||
                                (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 6 && ?pc67 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassOne)
                            )
                        ),
                        nltl:steelGradeB,
                        IF(
                            (
                                ?strength = nltl:normalStrengthSteelCategory &&
                                (
                                    (?band >= 2 && ?band <= 4 && ?pc15 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo)) ||
                                    (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 8 && ?pc15 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo) ||
                                    (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 8 && ?pc67 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo) ||
                                    (?band = 9 && ?pc67 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo))
                                )
                            ),
                            nltl:steelGradeD,
                            IF(
                                (
                                    ?strength = nltl:normalStrengthSteelCategory &&
                                    (
                                        (?band = 1 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree && ?pc15) ||
                                        (?band >= 2 && ?band <= 4 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree && ?pc15) ||
                                        (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 8 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo, nltl:steelMaterialClassThree) && ?pc15) ||
                                        (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 8 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree && ?pc67) ||
                                        (?band = 9 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo) && ?pc15) ||
                                        (?band = 9 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree && ?pc67)
                                    )
                                ),
                                nltl:steelGradeE,
                                IF(
                                    (
                                        ?strength = nltl:highTensileSteelCategory &&
                                        (
                                            (?band >= 1 && ?band <= 4 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo)) ||
                                            (?band = 1 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree && ?pc67) ||
                                            (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 9 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo) && ?pc67)
                                        )
                                    ),
                                    nltl:steelGradeAh,
                                    IF(
                                        (
                                            ?strength = nltl:highTensileSteelCategory &&
                                            (
                                                (?band >= 2 && ?band <= 4 && ?pc15 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo)) ||
                                                (?band >= 2 && ?band <= 4 && ?pc67 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree) ||
                                                (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 8 && ?pc15 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassOne) ||
                                                (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 8 && ?pc15 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo) ||
                                                (?band = 9 && ?pc15 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo))
                                            )
                                        ),
                                        nltl:steelGradeDh,
                                        IF(
                                            (
                                                ?strength = nltl:highTensileSteelCategory &&
                                                (
                                                    (?band >= 1 && ?band <= 4 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree && ?pc15) ||
                                                    (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 8 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo && ?pc15) ||
                                                    (?band >= 5 && ?band <= 8 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree) ||
                                                    (?band = 9 && ?pc15 && ?material IN (nltl:steelMaterialClassOne, nltl:steelMaterialClassTwo)) ||
                                                    (?band = 9 && ?pc67 && ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree)
                                                )
                                            ),
                                            nltl:steelGradeEh,
                                            IF(
                                                (
                                                    ?strength = nltl:highTensileSteelCategory &&
                                                    ?material = nltl:steelMaterialClassThree &&
                                                    (
                                                        (?band >= 7 && ?band <= 8 && ?pc13) ||
                                                        (?band = 9 && (?pc13 || ?pc45))
                                                    )
                                                ),
                                                nltl:steelGradeFh,
                                                nltl:benchmarkEntity
                                            )
                                        )
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    AS ?expected
                )

                OPTIONAL {
                    $this nltl:requiredHullStructuralSteelGrade ?required .
                }

                OPTIONAL {
                    ?actual nltl:steelGradeOrderRank ?actualRank .
                }

                FILTER(
                    ?expected = nltl:benchmarkEntity ||
                    !BOUND(?required) ||
                    ?required != ?expected ||
                    !BOUND(?actualRank) ||
                    EXISTS {
                        ?required nltl:steelGradeOrderRank ?requiredRank .
                        FILTER(?actualRank < ?requiredRank)
                    } ||
                    (
                        ?strength = nltl:normalStrengthSteelCategory &&
                        ?actual NOT IN (
                            nltl:steelGradeB,
                            nltl:steelGradeD,
                            nltl:steelGradeE
                        )
                    ) ||
                    (
                        ?strength = nltl:highTensileSteelCategory &&
                        ?actual NOT IN (
                            nltl:steelGradeAh,
                            nltl:steelGradeDh,
                            nltl:steelGradeEh,
                            nltl:steelGradeFh
                        )
                    )
                )
            }
